t: Deliver the Instructions on the Eternal Time Engine to the First Time Wanderer.

It's so good to see you!
We need to find my colleague as soon as possible. He must be wandering somewhere around here, in this time.
I'm planning a new experiment that will help us to better understand the nature of the time. If we cast two spells that feed each other with energy at the same point of space but in different timelines... Will we create an eternal temporal engine? Quite possible!
This package contains instructions for my colleague. Bring it to him, please.

What? Who are you?
Are you from the past, the future or the present?
New instructions! Let's see what my colleague suggests this time.
Deliver the messages from one Time Wanderer to another, then return to the Guardian of the Future.

As you know, there are many time travelers on Kirah. Some of them want to change the past, just like you, while the others, me including, study time, its paradoxes, the Ashes...
Two of my friends need help. They got in different timelines and lost the contact, but their experiments must be synchronized. Find the Time Wanderers on Kirah and help them to establish contact with each other by delivering their letters.

Have you delivered the letter?
Hmm... A couple of days ago I saw a Time Wanderer. He asked me for help again. Or was it a Wanderer from the past, the one you haven't helped yet?
Oh, it's so complicated...
Collect 5 Artifacts of the Odds from the Elementals of the Odds and bring them to the Guardian of the Future.

Have you ever heard about the Power of Reality? Fascinating topic! But it is not the only one. Except the Reality in the structure of which we are trying to invade, there is also the Odds. What would happen if...
Changing of the past leads to activization of the Odds. There are magical storms of Time, which form curious artifacts. I'd like to examine them.
You can see these artifacts on Kirah. Their nature is such that over time they lose their shape and become what they actually are - magic elementals. But even in such elementals we can find the artifacts we need.
So I urge you to find five of these artifacts and bring them to me. It's better to look for them in the northern part of the Blazing Mine. To accomplish this task, you have to fight the elementals. Be careful! The power of your enemy depends on the power of the Odds!
How is your fighting against the Odds?

Good job!
I'm going to examine these artifacts immediately.

Do you know why our Regiment was given the name of Rodogor? Too bad! You should have learned the lessons of history better.
Are you a new recruit? Nevermind, it doesn't matter! All you have to do now is destroying the League forces! Kill the Militants of the League, it will bring you respect among the ranks of the Rodogor Regiment of Kirah. Hurrah!
We were given the name of Rodogor because our Regiment excelled during the siege of the Grokh allod.

You did well!
Our Regiment never stepped back fighting against the League! They will never defeat us!
Bring 5 tokens of League officers to Filna the Nimble.

League Expeditionary Corps is essentially a crowd of bumpkins armed with pitchforks.
There is only a bunch of officers who know how to fight.
What does it all mean? If you kill the officers, the militants will flee! League Officers wear special tokens.
Bring them to me to earn respect of the Kirah Regiment!
Kanian aristocrats are taught swordsmanship from childhood up. They are dangerous bastards, remember that!

Four, five... Five tokens!
Good job!

Listen carefully, we don't have much time.
Not only we need to win this battle, we have to prevent such incidents in the future. League ships are of a great interest for us. How do they move across the Astral? No one knows yet, but we must find it out.
Our scouts noticed some parts of an Astral ship on the west coast. Bring them to me for studying.
Give me an isolated allod and some engineers, and I will reveal the secret of the League astral ships!
Great. Let's send these boxes over to Nezebgrad. The injured can wait.
Plant 6 bombs on the West Coast, then return to Yaver Merit.

They say a decisive battle will take place soon.
It's helpful to soften the enemy ranks before the combat starts.
This box contains magic bombs, charged with a powerful mental message filling the enemies with thoughts of their imminent death.
Plant 6 bombs on the west coast. Be careful - if you make a mistake, the bomb will detonate and you will be running in panic instead of an enemy. Note that you can't carry more than 4 bombs at a time.
Remember, the death is always near. My people knew it the hard way.

Fine. If the fight takes place tomorrow, you will smell fear coming from the West.
Ha ha, just kidding.

The reserves of meteorite ore in the Blazing Mine belong to us! Not a small piece will go to the League!
You can find a vein of meteorite ore in the center of the mine. Collect one chunk of ore and bring it to the geologist Sarbaz Habit. Don't take too much, the ore is heavy. Besides, you have to fight enemies on your way back.
Come on! Every chunk of this ore nails a coffin for the League!
It's done! I will tell Yaver Merit about your heroic deed.

We have joined forces with the League against our common enemy, but we won't stop the mining operations. The meteorite ore belongs to us! Not a small piece will go to the League!
You can find a vein of meteorite ore in the center of the mine. Collect one chunk of ore and bring it to the geologist Sarbaz Habit. Don't take too much, the ore is heavy. Besides, you will have to fight enemies on your way back.
It's done! I will tell Yaver Merit about your heroic deed.

Don't look at me like that! Yes, I'm scared! These demons... They frighten a lot of people.
You know, I heard a lot about you. They say you can kill the demons. This is just the right time to do it!
At least demons are not sided with the League...

Demons are dead! You can't even imagine how these words please my ear!
Now we can finally think about the future!
Use the Scepter to study the remains of 6 Fierce Demons, then return to Yaver Merit.

You know how to kill demons? Aren't you a real godsend!
We have encountered especially powerful demons here, and we'd like to study them using this magic scepter. Aim it on the remains of the defeated enemy and use it.
The more demons you study, the better the results will be.
Studying the demons is as important as destroying their portals.
Even in the moment of despair we must work hard studying the enemy. It will help us to fight them and survive.
Find 5 injured soldiers and use the Signal Flare to call the medic, then return to Filna the Nimble.

Many of our people are lying wounded in these cursed sands. Take this signal flare.
As soon as you find someone, launch it in the air, and a medic will come to aid the soldier.
Orcs are good medics. We are not afraid of blood.
Well done! The soldiers you saved today will cover you tomorrow.
Good job. We'll do better now that we know the weak spots of our enemies.
I can't wait for the final battle! How long are we going to stay here?
Good job! What's your name again? Sounds foreign. I'll try not to forget it!
Bring 5 Tokens of Imperial Officers to Ilya Maryasov.

I must say, the Empire is fighting hard, despite the fact that their defeat is inevitable. Their officers are fanatics who die saying the name of Nezeb.
I've noticed that if you kill just an officer or two, the whole Imperial squad loses courage. I hope your goal is clear. League lieutenants wear special tokens, bring me seven of them.
Each Imperial Officer goes through a training program in the City Council. This is how fanatics appear...

7 tokens? Perfect!
The Empire will lay down their arms soon!

I hope you know what the Expeditionary Corps is doing here on Kirah.
The whole thing is about the meteorite ore. This is a strategic resource required for Astral travels! And there is plenty of it on Kirah.
The Empire is trying to evacuate their reserves hastily. We must stop them.
You will find boxes with meteorite ore on the east coast of Kirah. Bring them to me, but be careful and beware of ambushes. Indeed, every bar of the meteorite ore is stained with blood!
Not all of us are returning home. Boxes of meteorite ore will take the place of the fallen soldiers.

10 boxes, just as I ordered.
Thank you. The Expeditionary Corps will never forget your heroic deed.
Plant 6 mines on the Eastern coast, then return to Rudolph de Doucer.

I'm a necromancer. This magical discipline doesn't have a lot of respect among the Elves. But I'm sure the magic of death is nothing to be ashamed of.
Especially at war. My art is in good demand here.
Let's take these magic bombs. I'm not going to lie, I've stolen the principle of their work from Zem engineers. But these devices are powered by the magic of death. Just as someone approaches this bomb, a rotting zombie appears. And if the enemy loses vigilance, in a moment there will be two zombies, ha ha!
Take six bombs from this box and plant them on the eastern coast. It's not safe to carry more, they can detonate suddenly. And be on your guard planting them - this is a brand new technology developed by our enemies!
I'm sure in the future we will rely on both necromancy and technology. These Zem guys are not fools at all!

Are the mines planted?
Great! Let the Imperials fight against the Undead now! One foot in the grave, ha ha ha...

I heard you visited the Blazing Mine? So you know what's going on there. Both we and the Empire are extracting the meteorite ore. You can join and help us.
You can find a vein of meteorite ore in the center of the mine. Collect one chunk of ore and bring it to the geologist Vasily Rudokopov. Don't take too much, the ore is heavy. Besides, you will have to fight enemies on your way back.
Meteorite ore is the basis of our future economy! Keep it in mind.
Thank you! I'll report of your deed to the commanders!

We have joined forces with the Empire against our common enemy, but we won't stop the mining operations.
You can find a vein of meteorite ore in the center of the mine. Collect one chunk of ore and bring it to the geologist Sarbaz Habit. Don't take too much, the ore is heavy. Besides, you will have to fight enemies on your way back.
Meteorite ore is the basis of our future economy! Keep it in mind.
Thank you! I'll report of your deed to the commanders!

Do you see what's going on? Who could imagine that our victorious expedition would come to such a dismal end! We're doomed.
Don't look at me like that! These demons... They are strong, cunning, ruthless. Many of our warriors lost courage. They curse the day we landed on Kirah.
Are you saying we can kill them? Well, prove it!
I'm so glad this final battle didn't happen! I doubt we would survive the pressure of the Empire.
What a great news! If the demons can be killed... This is our chance to survive!
Use the Scepter to study the remains of 6 Fierce Demons, then return to Rudolph de Doucer.

Don't panic. I'm repeating these words to myself over and over. Only my job stops me from falling into despair.
What job? Eniel, Lazarus and the Fidget Family put a lot of pressure on me - they want me to find a way to fight the demons off.
They ask me to enchant bombs and weapons. But I'm glad to be distracted from my problems. People say you're the one who can actually kill demons! I need your help then.
We have encountered especially powerful demons here, and I'd like to study them using this magic scepter. Aim it on the remains of the defeated enemy and use it. The more demons you study, the better the results will be.
Demons hold the powers of the Astral magic. Unfortunately we haven't explored it to full yet...
Now we can understand the nature of our enemies better. We will find their weak points!
Find 5 injured soldiers and use the Signal Flare to call the Sisters of Charity, then return to Ilya Maryasov.
Many of our people are lying wounded in these cursed sands. Take this signal flare. As soon as you find someone, launch it in the air, and a Sister of Charity will come to aid the soldier.
I owe my life to a Sister of Charity. She is like my... second mother.
Both you and the Sisters of Charity saved many lives. Thank you.

I must confess, I'm concerned with the morale of our troops. Speeches of bravery and demonic tentacles nailed to the poles won't help until the soldiers see how the demon dies.
Get to the outpost northeast of our camp and talk to the guard. Make sure he is watching you and kill at least a dozen of demons! Teach the soldiers how to deal with these beasts!
Thank you. Now I'm sure our soldiers won't lay down their weapon when demons appear.
Prevent the battle between the League and the Empire and return to Gorislav on the Crossroads.

As you might have guessed, your main goal is preventing the tomorrow's battle. League and Empire armies are ready to cut each other throats, but instead they must repulse the demonic attack, uniting against their common enemy.
How can you do it? By completing tasks of Eniel and others.
I hope you understand that "tomorrow" is just a figure of speech. It is always March 3, 910 here. Every day. This day won't end until you reach your goal. After that you'll be able to meet Gorislav and receive new tasks.

Fine! It means tomorrow Yasker and Eniel will meet the demons fully prepared.
But there's no tomorrow. There is only one and the same day that took place a century ago. And if they succeeded or failed, we will find out later.
Now you see how confusing the time can be!
Light up 5 Lamps of Time on your way to the Imperial Camp and meet Lazarus Valir.

Here you are! Are you going to scatter the Ashes over the heads of the poor ancestors? Hold it!
Listen to some safety precautions first.
You're a time Traveler from the future. Only you can see the Whirlpool of Time, the Wall of Time that separates this part of reality from another, and other signs of magic interfering with the past. None of these things exist for those who belong to this time. Still, people here are well aware of the war. For Xadaganians, orcs and the Arisen you are just an enemy, one of the many. They will attack you on sight.
But worry not - the Gift of Tensess is with you! If you die, you will resurrect either in the Whirlpool of Time or near another source of time, Able to go on with your quest.
Don't try to do everything in one day. Tomorrow here will be March 3, 910 again, and you will be able to take another chance.
Now go to the League Camp in the western Kirah. Follow the path. You can't miss it. You will see 5 Lamps of Time along the way. Touch them all. It's an important ritual. It'll make you a real traveler in time. You mark the path for those who follow you later.
The war is such a mess. The League soldiers will most likely reckon you are one of them. Especially if you won't be singing songs from the future or playing with mana batteries. You don't look very contemporary, but it should do for your main mission. Go to the League camp and report to Lazarus Valir that the Empire troops have captured an outpost. It's true, by the way.
How do I know? I read history books!
Stand at ease and report. We are not the Empire, and we don't need drilling.

So the enemy captured the outpost? We have to retake it!
Thank you for the information. What regiment are you from? Your uniform looks strange.
Oh I see, you are from the intel! They always stick to funny clothes.
Kill 5 Imperial Storm Troopers and Stomper the Rowdy to recapture the outpost, then return to Eniel de Ardeur.

I'm almost ready to cancel tomorrow's battle. But first we have to make sure that the Empire will not strike us a treacherous blow. As we all know, it can happen!
The Empire captured an outpost in the center of Kirah. If you manage to knock the enemy out of it, we will declare truce and start preparations to fight the demons!
Declare truce in order to start war with another unseen enemy... What's happening to this world?

You've done everything to stop this war. I'm ready to fulfill your request.
Tomorrow a battle will take place. But we will fight against demons, not the Empire!
Earn trust of the Expeditionary Corps and talk to Eniel de Ardeur again.

As you know, I'm not the only one who makes decisions here. Every citizen of the League has a right to state an opinion.
Lazarus and the Fidget Family trust you completely, so do I. But the rest of our commanders know nothing about you. They will not support the plan to cancel our attack on the Empire.
You have to become friends with my people. Only after that I'll be able to issue the order you want.
Complete the tasks to make Kirah soldiers and officers happy, earn their trust, then we'll talk.

Everyone trusts you now! That's a great achievement.
Now there is only one last thing to do...
Collect 8 tokens from the Imperial Scouts around the League Camp and bring them to Lazarus Valir.

Hmmm... Should I call medic or executioner? You are either out of your mind or trying to provoke and act of treason. Cancelling tomorrow's battle!
I don't know what to think... Anyway, this is Eniel's duty. But he will come to ask for my advice...
For a starter, let's see if you are a spy or not. There are Imperial scouts hanging around our camp. Kill them and bring me their tokens as a proof. I guess a spy wouldn't kill their own people.
It's great when there is a room for nobility during a war. We should settle all arguments by setting up a tournament. It's exciting and not as disastrous!

Tokens of the Imperial Scouts. It means you are on our side.
Great.
Deliver a note from Lazarus Valir to Eniel de Ardeur.

I've checked all registers and couldn't find you anywhere. It means your story about the future, the demons, death of Tensess and our new capital must be true.
I wrote a letter to Eniel. Bring it to him. He should know that I believe you.
A decisive battle will be hold tomorrow... We must get prepared.

What is this? A letter from Lazarus?
Valir is so naive. Sometimes I feel like he came from past, from an old legend where there is no place for a Whirlpool of Time!
Bring the following items to Eniel de Ardeur: The Chronicles of the Past, a Tentacle of Kixxar the Keeper and de Ardeur Family Tree.

I hope you realize that your story sounds insane. But I don't want to make hasty decisions.
Prove your words. I see your unusual clothing, but it's not enough to make me believe that tomorrow we will be attacked by demons.
Get back to your time and find me some evidences.
I need a book of history that confirms all I heard from you. I suppose you can buy it from traders in our new capital.
Tentacle of a demon... from a Gipat dungeon, you mentioned its name... Kixxar the Keeper!
And the most importantly, de Ardeur family tree. Have you met my relatives in your time? I'm sure they hold high positions. Talk to one of them, they should help you.

I can't believe my eyes! Are these items from the future?!
What a horrible tentacle... Are we going to fight these creatures tomorrow?!
A book of history... I will read it in my free time...
And my family tree. So, where am I?
What's this? Why is my branch marked with a gravestone?!
Fill the bottle with water from the Whirlpool of Time and bring it to the Fidget Family.

We believe you! Of course!
Travels in time... This is great! A hundred times better than Astral travels! Pity we haven't discovered it earlier.
If only we could jump in some temporal ship and turn on full steam ahead! What's "ahead"? What's there in the future?!
I have an idea! Hooray! Bring us some water from the Whirlpool of Time! We will fill up the engine with it and fly to the future to see it ourselves! What do you think?
I would like to return to the past and have a look at Isa... It must be so beautiful!

Here it is, the Water of Time! Let's have a look...
The bottle is empty! Are you trying to make fools of us?!
Deliver a letter from the Fidget Family to Eniel de Ardeur.

The bottle is empty? It seems we can't see these time-related magical things. What a pity...
I wish we could travel into the past and see our homeland! Okay, take this letter. It says that we trust you. Do you know why? Because we want it to be true! Not that we are glad to meet the demons... It's just interesting!
Take this note to Eniel. He's in charge. Let him know that we support you!
It's time to finish this operation and drive the Imperials away from Kirah!

What's this? A note from the Fidget Family?
I had no doubts they would believe you. Gibberlings are like little children, they love listening to magical stories.
Interrogate three officers of the Imperial Army to find out a weak spot of Yasker, then talk to Eniel de Ardeur.

Let's forget about our feelings and get back to the facts.
Lazarus and the Fidget Family trust you. I should believe you too, judging by these evidences. Especially the family tree. You know, it's terrible to know that you are going to die soon.
I offer you a deal. Help me change the future, and I will help you change the past.
The papers say that Yasker kills me during the war in the year 957, when Imperial fleet invades Kania. I want to prepare myself for this battle and defeat Yasker!
I should get to know my enemy first. Go to the Imperial camp, find three officers of the Empire and interrogate them. We need to find out the weak spot of Yasker!
Of course we can try and kill Yasker now... But it's not what you want, isn't it? It will destroy all hopes for the peace.

So, necromancy is Yasker's weak spot! He is afraid of the undead like a little boy!
I should make use of it!

What? Are you going to interrogate me? Do you want me to reveal the secrets of our command?
Well, listen to me! Yasker has no secrets! He is a Great Mage, a disciple of Nezeb himself, hallowed be his name! Yasker is perfect! Do you understand? I doubt that. Your Tensess can't even be compared with our leader.
This is over. I won't tell you anything!
I'm going to study necromancy to surprise Yasker in the future! I should talk to Rudolph... This de Doucer guy is smart if he's into it...

Great. It was a nice start.
Don't worry, it's not over yet. Yasker is doomed!
Kill 7 Goblin Miners and 7 Mine Guards at the Blazing Mine, then return to Eniel de Ardeur.

Now that the problem with Yasker is solved, we can focus on other affairs.
As you know, the goal of our Kirah operations is meteorite ore. We have captured a part of the Blazing Mine and started the extraction, but a large segment is still under control of our enemies. So the League and the Empire are now fighting underground. Until the mine is ours, I can't even think about truce.
You can change everything. Help us to clean up the mine from the Imperial soldiers and miners!
Who could have believed that meteorite ore will become the most valuable resource in the world!
If all League citizens are as loyal as you... The Empire is doomed!
Collect 5 tentacles from the Twisted Predators on Kirah and nail them to the pole at the northeastern League Camp, then return to Lazarus Valir.

Eniel must be a prophet - he told me that you would come. I must confess, I'm glad to see you.
You know, we are in a terrible situation. Of course, we explained everything to our soldiers, they saw the tentacle you brought, but they are confused. The enemy is still terrible and unknown!
I want you to show them how it's done! Kill some demons and nail their tentacles to the pole northeast of our camp. It will cheer up our soldiers!
When I saw the first demon, I was terrified. It's a real monster! Where did they come from?
Thank you so much! I heard our commanders' talk. We shouldn't be afraid. We will defeat the demons! You inspired us. Thank you again.
Place the Standard at the portal to seal it.

We must destroy this portal, seal it forever and keep the demons far away from the meteorite ore reserves on Kirah.
Consecrated Standard will help you better than Rudolph's magic bombs, just place it near the portal!
I'm so glad to see you!

All is set and done! The portal is closed, your mission is complete.
What are you saying? A strange demon attacked you? A demon that even you have never seen before?!
Hm... I'm sorry, but I have nothing to tell you. Return to your time and ask those who sent you here.
Raise the Standard, then return to Lazarus Valir.

Eniel and the Fidget Family decided to entrust you with the Standard of the Expeditionary Corps.
This banner is not only a symbol of fidelity, honor and valor, but also a powerful magic artifact.
Take it and you will feel its power.
Don't be scared. Get the Battle Standard ready!

Well? Aren't you impressed?!
Believe me, this Standard will help you on your important mission in the center of Kirah. Yes, Eniel told me. That's why we decided to give you the Standard.
Collect Clots of Astral Energy from the demons of Kirah and bring them along with the Standard to Eniel de Ardeur.

There is a Big Mine northeast of our camp. This name was given to a place by Empire miners. According to their research, it holds huge reserves of meteorite ore. Empire engineers built Mecha-Mole - a colossal machine that drills the earth and crushes the rock. I've seen it from afar, it's very impressive!
If the demons want to destroy the reserves of meteorite ore, they will strike exactly where Mecha-Mole stands.
Let's start with upgrading your Standard - it will make you stronger. Hunt down the demons and collect Clots of Astral Energy. Rudolph de Doucer examined the remains of demons killed near the camp and came to conclusion that their bodies contain enough energy to improve the Standard.
I'm sure we'll learn a lot about the Astral demons.
I'll try to upgrade your Standard with these magical clots. Wait a second...
Place the Standard on top of Mecha-Mole and protect it while it absorbs the powers of defeated enemies, then summon the Shadow of Eniel.

If the Mole gets to the deposits of meteorite ore, the demons will be weakened... It's worth trying!
Place the Standard on top of Mecha-Mole. It will draw demons, but if you survive their attacks and protect the Standard, it will absorb the powers of your determination and despair of your enemy.
Summon me again when you complete the ritual.
So? Have you finished the ritual?
Done! The Standard will now make your wish come true!

Strange black shadows started to appear on Kirah soon after we have first encountered the Demons. Even our summoners are unaware of their nature. However, we are not going to study them right now. Shadows are a great source of the Ghostly Essences. Get 18 samples of this magical substance and bring it to me.
I think the origin of the Shadows can be easily explained. You'll find them where grief, misfortune and troubles are.
We have collected the Ghostly Essence. Now we can proceed with my plan.
Plant three magical bombs at the first group of demonic portals, then report to the Fidget Family.

We've been waiting for you! Who else can come close to the demonic portal and blow it up?
The problem is that we don't know which school of magic would work against the portals. Rudolph de Doucer constructed fire, glacial and lightning bombs to find it out. He also wanted to employ his favorite magic of death, but changed his mind. He said that it wouldn't affect the demons.
Take the mines and try to blow up three demonic portals. I hope at least one of them will be effective.
You'd better use the first group of portals, they are somewhat larger than the newer ones. They stood there for a long time, so there is a chance that their powers weakened and the bombs will work.
And one more thing. The tests should be performed at different portals to make the results more reliable.

Damn, what a pity!
I'll ask Rudolph to make more powerful bombs. We must destroy these portals!
Summon the Shadow of Eniel on top of the hill and talk to him, then return to the League camp.

I can't follow you in all your adventures, but my shadow can.
I'm using the Ghostly Essences you collected to enchant this wand. When you complete your task, use it to summon my shadow and speak with it to receive new instructions.
Let's try and see how it works. Climb up the hill to the east and use the wand to talk to my shadow.
Did you enjoy talking to my Shadow?

I'm real. Touch me if you don't believe my words.
And still, I remember in details how we met the last time...
This is magic!
Repel the demonic attack at the northern League Outpost, then use the charm to summon Eniel's Shadow.

As far as I know, you have already received the Standard and helped the Fidget Family to construct a new bomb. You might need both these items later.
For now, I want you to perform a reconnaissance mission for me. There is an outpost to the north of our camp protecting the road to the Big Mine. We have lost contact with its garrison, and I want you to find out what happened. I'm afraid the demons have reached the place. Use the Standard to fight them. Summon my shadow when you're done.
Wait a second! I just want to look around...

They're all dead... Everyone!
The outpost is destroyed. I don't think we can use it anymore. Go back to the camp.
Use the Standard to kill demons and get to Mecha-Mole, then summon Eniel's Shadow.

Now you can go to the Big Mine. There is a good chance that demons will attack you on your way to the Mecha-Mole. The upgraded Standard will help you to deal with them.
Find the Mecha-Mole and summon my shadow, I'll tell you what to do next.
These demonic corpses... Did you kill them?
Offer your help to survivors, earn their trust, then summon Eniel's Shadow.

Hm... Parts of this gigantic mechanism are still operational!
If you find any remnants of the Empire forces, try to ally with them and offer your assistance. I think under these circumstances they will forget about our ideological differences. Summon me again as soon as you earn their trust.
I see you have found an approach to the Empire citizens! Congratulations.
So the Engineer wants to start up the Mole... Sounds good...
Use the lever to start up the machine. Defeat the demons, then summon Shadow of Eniel.

Time to start the engine of the Mecha-Mole.
The controls are in front of you. As soon as it starts working, the demons will try to stop it. You will have to fight them.
And don't use the magic of the Consecrated Standard yet. We will need it at a later point.
So, the enemy has been defeated...

This is the final test...
The beast that could destroy all meteorite ore on Kirah is now dead... But the portal where it came from still stands!
Now I think I know how we shall use the Standard's power!
Deliver Eniel's letter to his daughter Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

It's you again! I was hoping for you to come.
We held out in the battle, but failed with our main mission. Demons ruined our game. We decided to evacuate. People are waiting for our protection on Kania, Umoira, Forox... Tensess is dead! Oh you've probably heard...
Damn it! I didn't have time to complete the most important mission. I can't get into the cave.
We know little about the enemy, but there are those who know more! My daughter, Marianne... You told me that she was an important League official. I'm proud of her and I'm sure she can help me.
Here, this is a letter for her. Please don't read it, there is too much of personal information. Writing a letter to your daughter in the future... you don't get such opportunity every other day. Deliver this message to her and bring me her answer.

How can I help you?
Do you have any more questions about my family?

A letter? From my father?
It sounds like a cruel joke!
Get back to your time and meet Marianne de Ardeur.

I guess you are wondering why I need this Heart? Believe me, this is a powerful artifact.
Any Great Mage would give away a part of his powers in exchange for it. Because...
Sorry, I'm not in position to share it with you. It's a secret of Conclave, of all my colleagues.
But I can tell you something else instead. The news about my death from Yasker's hand forced me to act. Necromancy is great... But it doesn't guarantee my victory over him.
The Heart does. This is a weapon! A powerful one-time charge capable of killing any enemy. The nature of these powers is not yet clear even to the Great Mages. We only know that there are twelve such artifacts in the world. In the past, the Great Dragons were among them.
Things have changed now, the Dragons are almost gone, but the Heart is still in full power, and it will allow me to defeat Yasker. I will change the future.
When you return to your time, I'll be alive, and Yasker will be dead. Go and find out if it's true. Ask my daughter Marianne about changes in the world I made with this Heart. She will also reward you for your help.

I've been waiting for you.
My father wrote in his last will how he met you on Kirah and how you helped them.
Unfortunately, my father's hopes never came true... During his fight against Yasker they both used a secret weapon - a Heart of the Dragon. A power absorbed another power... My father failed to change the future. Is it possible at all?
For a long time, I knew nothing about his last will. And now... this ancient, time-worn scroll tells me about his plans, about my letter that you delivered into the past. I remember how I wrote it! But at the same time, I'm sure that when I studied the reports on the demons, trying to figure out the way to kill this Archdemon from the past...Back then I knew nothing about my father's last will!
It's very confusing. I believe the games with Time should be played by Gods, not us mortals.
Now I want to fulfill the will of my father. He asked me to reward you generously. I'm happy to do his bidding.
Deliver the letter to Eniel de Ardeur in the past.

That's... That's his handwriting!
In a meeting with Aidenus, Izbor said the mysterious Director was now sending our citizens into the past, to Kirah... That's where my father is...
Did you see him?! How is he?! I can hardly remember him. My dad was killed when I was a little girl...
O Great Light! My thoughts are getting all mixed up! He's asking me for so much!
Oh! His plans... They are correct. But also risky! Wait, I have to write him a reply...
Here!
My letter to my father. It contains answers to all of his questions. He has a chance to fulfill his plans. If you help him!
Do this, and I'll reward you handsomely, I swear by the Light!
We put everything at stake... Everything!

Well... What did she write?
I see... Wow! The art of magic really stepped ahead in the future!
Oh my dear daughter... I'm sorry. This is something personal...
Collect all ingredients to complete the special training.

Listen to me.
I can't do this without your help. I need time to implement my plan, but I don't have it.
The situation is not the same with you. I trust you so much, that I'm ready to tell you something extremely important.
Our expedition has another goal except meteorite ore. Heart of the Great Dragon, that is protected by the elite soldiers of the Empire. Do not ask me why the League needs the Heart. I can't answer this question. I'm just asking you to help me.
The problem is that to approach and to touch the Heart can only those who have gone under special training. I don't have much time, so you have to do this for me.
 If you make up your mind to help me, then you have to complete three difficult tasks. When you done with them, we can assume that you are willing to help me.
Are you ready?

For me it's the same long and agonizing day, over and over.
The day of the endless waiting!
For you it's been at least four days! But now I'm sure that you won't fail.

Archdemon is the major obstacle to the Secret Cave where the Heart of the Dragon is located. The Heart attracts demons as much as the meteorite ore. Both these substances can resist the Astral, so they want to destroy them.
Killing the Archdemon is extremely difficult. But Marianne has been fighting with them for a hundred years, so she invented something. Have you heard of a combat advantage?
Warriors gain it in a fight to use against their enemies. If you accumulated a lot of advantage, you can do something unprecedented.
You will accumulate your advantages fighting the beasts similar to the Archdemon. They are dangerous too, so you'd better bring your friends.
These demons can be found in the northern Kirah. Killing one of them will grant you a Demonic Substance. Bring me 10 Substances, and I'll transform them into the Sign of Superiority, you will require it to kill the Archdemon.
Seven days for you, but one long and painful day for me...

Fine. Now I can create a Sign of Superiority...
Here it is.

There is a demonic portal on the way to the Secret Cave that must be closed.

Otherwise, there is a chance that the demons will stab you in the back.

Demonic portals use the same principles as ours. You can attune to their portal to become a Guardian and get the full control over it. It won't be easy, though.

You will be able collect one particle of the portal at a time.

Bring me 10 particles, and I'll create a shard you need to complete your mission.
According to Marianne's letter, demons represent serious danger in the future. Many of the techniques she described are not even battle tested yet...

Great! Give me these particles...
Here is your shard. Keep it safe!

The last difficulty is the Heart itself. For the next four days, you must prepared yourself to touch it.
Black Dragons that inhabit the northern Kirah will grant you protection against the heat of the Dragon's Heart. When a dragon dies, its last breath scorches its enemy.
Use this chance to expose yourself to the flames. It's the only way to obtain a particle of the Eternal Fire.
Bring me ten of them, and I'll create a protective Clot of the Eternal Fire for you.
Only a select few passed this training...
I can use these particles to create the magical clot. One of the four clots we need.
Bring the Dragon's Heart to Eniel de Ardeur.

The time has come for you to do what was considered impossible.
Listen carefully. You are going to cross the bridge to the north, find the demonic portal and seal it. After that, kill the Archdemon.
When it's done, defeat Vlad and his elite squad of Nezeb Falcons guarding the cave, collect the key and retrieve the Heart of the Dragon.
We put everything at stake... Everything!

Yes! This is the Dragon's Heart!
Now I'm saved!
Bring the mysterious substance to the Guardian of the Future.

Apparently, this item is magical. The one who discovers its mystery will become more experienced.
Perhaps the Guardian of the Future knows more about it.
Do you have any news for me?

It's a concentrated experience of the past.
A small piece of knowledge that you will bear from now on.
Bring the mysterious substance to the Guardian of the Future.

Apparently, this item is magical. The one who discovers its mystery will become more experienced.
Perhaps the Guardian of the Future knows more about it.
Do you have any news for me?

It's a concentrated experience of the past.
A large piece of knowledge that you will bear from now on.
Bring the mysterious substance to the Guardian of the Future.

Apparently, this item is magical. The one who discovers its mystery will become more experienced.
Perhaps the Guardian of the Future knows more about it.
Do you have any news for me?

It's a concentrated experience of the past.
A relatively big piece of knowledge that you will bear from now on.
Bring the mysterious substance to the Guardian of the Future.

Apparently, this item is magical. The one who discovers its mystery will become more experienced.
Perhaps the Guardian of the Future knows more about it.
Do you have any news for me?

It's a concentrated experience of the past.
A relatively small piece of knowledge that you will bear from now on.
Bring the treasure to the Guardian of the Future.
This item must be worth something. Maybe the Guardian of the Future will find use for it?
Have you got any good news?

Hm... What a curious time anomaly. A good piece of wealth from the days of the past...
It's very expensive!
Bring the treasure to the Guardian of the Future.

This item must be worth something.
Maybe the Guardian of the Future will find use for it?
Have you got any good news?

Hm... What a curious time anomaly. A good piece of wealth from the days of the past...
It's very expensive!
Bring the treasure to the Guardian of the Future.
This item must be worth something. Maybe the Guardian of the Future will find use for it?
Have you got any good news?

Hm... What a curious time anomaly. A good piece of wealth from the days of the past...
It isn't cheap!
Bring the treasure to the Guardian of the Future.
This item must be worth something. Maybe the Guardian of the Future will find use for it?
Have you got any good news?

Hm... What a curious time anomaly. A good piece of wealth from the days of the past...
It isn't cheap!
Collect 4 Large Astral Druses from Demon Destroyers and bring them to the Guardian of the Future.

Has Gorislav told you about the Destroyers? Demon assassins from the future that try to stop you?
You'd have a better chance of survival if you find them and deliver the first blow.
Take this ritual knife. Find a demonic portal, equip the Charm of the Astral Silver, then cut your wrist and sprinkle the portal with your blood. The Destroyer will scent it and rush to you through time. Upon defeating it, you will collect a Small Astral Druse.
Use three of such Druses to summon a Hardened Destroyer that drops a Medium Astral Druse. Three Medium Druses will summon a Fierce Destroyer, an extremely dangerous demon!
You should bring friends to defeat him, and remember: each of them must also have the Charm of the Astral Silver.
Defeat the Fierce Destroyer to receive a Large Astral Druse. Bring me four of them, and I'll reward you.
The war against the Destroyers is a test of your strength. I wish you luck.
You are among the select few worthy of this reward. Wear it proudly!
Read the Mysterious Letter in your mailbox, then talk to Gorislav Gipitsky at the tavern on Coba Plateau.

Hmm... There is another letter for you here, a very interesting one. Again, the sender is some Director or other. There is no return address, no stamp or seal.... How did it get to its destination at all? It is for good reason that our postal system is considered to be the best in the world!
Speak up, I am a little hard of hearing.
What? A letter? I don't know anything about a letter!
Find the 3 Stones of Igsh Military District and report back to anthropologist Shrinka the Forester.

Hmph. To be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your surroundings.
As a test, I have placed three stones imbued with magic around Igsh Military District. Explore great area, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Imperial Training Camp, Old Barracks, and Lookout Isle. Good luck.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself.
Collect 4 IMD Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Shrinka the Forester.

Hey, I know you're a seasoned traveler and all, but Igsh Military District is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill four of IMD's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of the squall elemental, Dryhoof, Speartusk, a gigantic ravenous spider, a gigantic steppe centipede, an agitated tawny deer, Filthmane... And so on and so forth...
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Defeat 50 Blue Soldiers in IMD and report back to anthropologist Shrinka the Forester.

Everywhere you go you'll see people talking about how a group of so-and-sos is so dangerous and must be dealt with... and Igsh Military District is no different!
I'm not talking about any dangerous creatures, this area has long since been... er... domesticated. I'm talking about those damned Blues! See, you're a member of the Red team, so that means that your duty is to fight the Blues!
Anytime a Blue soldier comes to me, I tell him to hunt the red! Oh, I hope you guys meet...

Excellent!
Of course, I knew that Red was superior to Blue!
Collect 5 IMD weapons for anthropologist Shrinka the Forester.

There are a lot of valuable resources in our world... But there's nothing of much value here in the Igsh Military District.
Except weapons! This is the most valuable resource for army. There is a constant shortage for them!
Why? Because when young soldiers get a sword in their hands they start going nuts. They let the power go to their heads and let their guards down and that's when they make some sort of fatal mistake and end up in some ditch with our weapons!
So I need you to go out and collect the swords, shields, and maces of the fallen!

Good.
Now we'll have something to distribute to the new soldiers. Hopefully they'll have more smarts!
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Shrinka the Forester.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in the Igsh Military District!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Meet Perst the Crafty at the southern gates of Nezebgrad to find the way to the Recruitment Center.

Every citizen of the Empire is obliged to serve in the army for a period of time. The enemy never sleeps, and if anything happens, every Imperial citizen has to know how to defend themselves. Aside from that, the army is where you can really learn about life. I've no time for anyone that hasn't served in the army!
I believe that your formal training was interrupted by a Kanian attack on the ship you were serving on. It's time to leave this soft civilian life behind and rejoin the ranks of the army.
That means it's time for you to visit the Igsh Military District. Make your way to Perst the Crafty at the southern gates of Nezebgrad, he will send you to the recruitment center.
It's time for you to once again defend the Motherland as an Imperial Sentinel.
Come again? Speak louder, I can't hear you!
Take Preminina's Report to Oleg Pravdin in Nezebgrad.

Fewer recruits have been joining us lately. Can you believe that not every citizen of the Empire would be proud to serve in our valiant army? For shame!
I just know the League is behind this. They are corrupting those still weak minds! They undermine the great Empire's military might! If this keeps up, then our enemy will easily conquer us in a few years. No - I will not allow our great country to fall apart!
I have detailed all of my proposed solutions in this document. We need to step up our propaganda efforts and fight this indifference. Please take this document directly to Oleg Pravdin at the Old Square in Nezebgrad. He's both an Imperial Sentinel and a member of the City Council, so he's the perfect man to spearhead this project!
Oh, and don't wear yourself out. You can use that portal right over there to get back to Nezebgrad. Sarang Ankhmakis will fill you in. I trust this request will be completed in a timely manner!

Is everything well in my country? Did I do everything I could have done?
These are the questions every true citizen of the Empire should be asking themselves on a daily basis!
What's the matter? There's a report from Commissar Preminina? I'll make sure to read this immediately. She doesn't waste her time on petty issues. She is a true daughter of the Empire!
Meet Marianna Preminina at the recruitment center.

Are you the new recruit?
Great. Serve well, and you'll become just like me!
Follow this road to the south, and you'll see the recruitment center. Report to Marianna Preminina, commissioner of Igsh Military District.
Oh, she'll be delighted...
Come again? Speak louder, I can't hear you!
Speak with Clang the Forester at the IMD recruitment center.

The descendants of the Legendary Orc are here among us and we have to find them. Your appearance is not simply chance - you were brought to us by the spirits.
All of the Imperial Orcs pass through the Imperial Training Grounds in the Igsh Military District. That's to our advantage.
One of our shamans works there and thanks to his powers, he cannot just filter out the weaklings and the cowards, but he can also identify those who have advanced magical abilities.
Go and find that shaman and tell him about your mission. His name is Clang the Forester.

These new recruits are driving me crazy. One of them's allergic to spider bites, and another one's afraid of ghosts. What about you?
So, you're the one that's been chosen to seek out the descendants of the Legendary Orc. When I was little, I used to hope that I would be the Chosen One! No such luck, I suppose. Let's hope you can live up to your title.
Deliver the Package of Necrotechnology to the Necro-Incubator worker in the Igsh Military District.

For the moment we don't have any proof that Tep is alive, but the activities of his acolytes gives us cause to be afraid. We need to find out whether Tep is behind what they are doing, or whether they are acting independently.
Among the Tablets that you found is a description of some interesting necrotechnology. You must deliver a package containing this information to the Recruitment Center. A worker from the Necro-Incubator will be waiting for you there.
It's possible that by studying these Tablets we might be able to discover what happened to Tep. But even if we don't, studying the tracks he left behind won't be a wasted effort either.
Where's the package? I haven't got any time to lose.

My word, these techniques were considered lost long ago! There is some very interesting information here, and I'm sure we'll be able to put it to good use. Thank you for your assistance! I'm sure the directors at the Necro-Incubator will be in need of your help in the future. Make sure to check back for new orders soon.
Meet the agent of the City Council in the Igsh Armory.

A serious miscalculation was made with Nezeb's Staff.
We had always supposed that it simply emitted energy, but the League has proven that this is not the case. We don't know how our experts managed to mess up, or how the enemy managed to obtain superior information. Your job is to figure out exactly what happened. Yasker himself commanded that this mission be completed and if there's another failure, heads will roll.
The only surviving member of the original team of experts that studied the Staff is in the Igsh Military District. The man in question is the master weaponsmith Yasskul Addaya. We've already planted a spy among his workers. Go see our inside agent and find out what he's learned.

I'm sick of doing all this dirty work.
I'm an agent with license to kill! Where are all the beautiful women, the cocktails, and the adventures?
Ah well. There's no point in crying about it. Until I get to the bottom of this Staff business, I can forget about that promotion. Let me fill you in on what's been happening.
Interrogate Miroslav Patsayev, the Unlucky Family, and Anabelle de Vevre and report to Larisa Nevolina.

Ignat Petrovin has turned out to be a traitor! He organized an escape, supplied weapons to the prisoners, and personally killed the guards.
The fugitives have taken refuge in an empty termite mound near the prison. They're also holding one of our men hostage. His name is Voxar the Fierce, but he's going to have to sit tight for a little longer. The City Council has delayed all rescue operations until we've questioned some of the remaining prisoners.
I don't have time to do it myself - I need to write a report on this mess. I'm ordering you to give this truth serum to the prisoners and see if they have anything meaningful to say. Report your findings to Larisa Nevolina so she can start the rescue operation immediately!
We're not going to storm the termite mound until we've figured out exactly what's going on! Did you manage to find out anything from the prisoners?
So our fugitives are waiting for outside help? Very interesting...

I'm only a guardsman. Who might want to save someone like me? No one is going to save us. It's all a big joke.
When I was a child, I dreamt of becoming a general, but they told me only children of generals would be allowed to reach that rank. So I ended up becoming a cannoneer. Boom! Hah! I even have a marksmanship badge. Do you want to see it? Hm, where is it? It's gone! Did you steal it?
They'll come after you eventually! Who? They... They'll be here soon. The Empire will be finished, and I'll be a general. That's how it's going to be!
Get to the termite mound and plant 3 Enhanced Bugs. Report back to Larisa Nevolina in Termitka Prison.

We still don't have enough information about the situation. The fugitives seem to be expecting help to arrive, but what kind of help and where's it coming from? I've decided to send one of our people into the termite mound to install some bugging devices.
This is a very dangerous mission, which means you're just the soldier to take it on! With the help of a little magic we're going to turn you into a Gibberling. I know, I know - very unpleasant, but it can't be helped! You need to be able to blend in perfectly with the other prisoners so that you can plant the bugs in secret. Return to me on the double after they're all hidden!
Has it been done? There's a great deal depending on this mission you know.
So, it would seem that our little masquerade worked out quite well. Now we know what the fugitives are saying. They're expecting the League to come to their aid shortly. How wrong they are!
Meet with Ignat Petrovin and give him the Fragment of Nezeb's Ship.

Now there is no doubt that Nezeb's Staff was stolen by none other than Ignat Petrovin. Go down into the termite hill and find out what his motives were. With your Gibberling disguise I'm sure he'll talk to you, but the only question is whether he'll be open and honest.
I've got an idea. I have a relic which will help us gain his trust. It's a piece of the ship Nezeb traveled in on his last journey. Tell Ignat that you have managed to steal it from the prison overseer's office. He'll do anything to get his hands on a holy relic like that.
Once you gain his trust you can question him thoroughly! We need names, passwords, information about secret meeting places... basically, everything that will allow us to uncover the League's network of secret agents.
I should have known he was crazy as soon as I heard he was a pacifist. How could anyone give up fighting?

So, he thinks that the League citizens deserve to be treated with respect, eh? Well now that we know for sure that they have no immediate reinforcements coming, it's time to launch our assault! Good work, soldier!
Get the Shiny Key by killing the guards and release Voxar the Fierce.

Maybe you should get me out of here before we continue this little chat, eh? I think it's pretty obvious that I'm being held here against my will.
When those damned prisoners escaped they decided that they should take a hostage with them. Why did I have to choose that day to drink on duty!? If I had had my wits about me I would have beat them to a pulp!
That viper Balandov has the key. He stays pretty close to the cell, yakking about salvation and throwing dirty glares at the Imperial soldiers up the hill. Kill him, get the key, and get me out of here!
Get me out of here or get lost!
Good job! Now I can get away from these filthy prisoners.
Escort Voxar the Fierce back to Termitka Prison.

Alright, let's stop wagging our tongues and get out of here! That cage was starting to get pretty filthy. Once we make it to the top of that hill we should be pretty safe. There's a ton of Yasker Hawks guarding it, watching the fugitives night and day.
Once we get there, don't forget to pass on the information that I fought like a tiger when they jumped me! And that I single handedly took out most of these weaklings on the way back.
I suppose I'll drop by and see Wrokag when I can. As an Orc it's my duty to obey his orders, but I don't like those shamans... I'm a real Orc! A true warrior, not some skirt-wearing coward!
Yes? Do you have more news to report?
Excellent work soldier! That saves us a lot of time and effort. Now that the hostage is out of the way, we can launch our offensive soon. I'll make sure the right authorities learn of your help!
Deliver the Sealed Package to Colonel Shpagin at the Dead Shore Training Grounds.

Thank you for your help, it was truly invaluable. I'm convinced that with a soldier like you in their ranks the Reds' losing streak will soon end.
I hope you know that your training exercises have only just begun, though. Take this package to Colonel Shpagin. He's located at the Dead Shore Training Grounds and is to be your next commanding officer. It has some important documents that he needs, and even a little note commending you on your efforts. Good luck!
What's this? An urgent order from the City Council? Let's see what it is they need!

Well, well. The package also contains an order in regards to your new promotion. It seems that congratulations are in order!
Now that you've made it this far, you're going to have a chance to show what you can really do.
Take 4 Hyena Ears to Shildar the Wily.

I don't have much time so I'll keep this brief.
There are two battalions based in our district: the Reds and the Blues. The two battalions are always competing against each other. It helps maintain the fighting spirit.
You will join up with the Red Battalion, code name Lions. The Blues are known as the Hyenas, so on your way to the base you'll need to kill some hyenas as part of your initiation ritual. It's very simple! Obtain 4 hyena ears and hand them over to your commanding officer, Shildar the Wily. Then you will become a full-fledged soldier.
Remember that this is not just some game! If you want a career in the army, you need to be able to devote yourself entirely to your battalion!
Can you handle a weapon? We don't need any faint-hearted types. The Blues are already winning most matches as it is.

So you can take care of some hyenas. Hmph. Well that was a pretty easy mission, so don't expect me to be jumping for joy.
What we need now is not some ears, but revenge! I hope you've got some battle experience, because now it's time to find out exactly what you're made of!
Obtain 4 Deer Antlers and give them to Igor Zorin in exchange for drinks.

Hey there rookie! There's no need to be afraid of me! Reds, Blues... it's all just a game you know. We're all on the same side - comrades-in-arms and all that! Soon this kindergarten stuff will be over and we'll be right there together on the front!
We should drink to new acquaintances! Do you know where to get some liquor? I'll let you in on a little secret - the quartermaster keeps an ample supply of booze. You just need to bring him something to offer in exchange.
In fact, I know just what would do the trick - deer antlers! He loves to make out that he's a big hunter, but he's really just a coward and a skirt-chaser. If you bring him some nice antlers I'm sure he'd share some of his stash!
We don't have any liquor! None, I said!
Hmm... Nobody seems to be looking. Give 'em here. Careful, don't drop 'em! And this is for you. Hide it someplace right now! There are too many eyes around...
Report to Maya Shinelina at the Red Barracks.

Stand at attention, soldier! I'm Semer Buneb and I'm responsible for enforcing discipline around here. To put it simply, I'm in charge of punks like you!
Since you've gotten here I've noticed several breaches of conduct already - poaching, bribing an official, and possession of alcohol on a military base.
What's going on? The Blues told you to do it? So you've been caught and you're trying to blame it on others, eh? You Reds are all the same - lying cowards! You will have to answer for your mistakes, soldier.
You will report to your officer about your behavior issues and you will receive your punishment. And don't even think about keeping quiet - I will be personally checking to make sure you did it!

Man, those Blues really duped you! The alcohol trick is an old one, you should have guessed. In accordance with the regulations I am obliged to take action. Let's see if you can manage to dodge most of the work and get even with the Blues!
Bring 3 Frightened Lion Cubs to Pin the Merciless at the Recruitment Center.

Aha, reinforcements. I've served with the Reds for quite a while, but soon my term will be over and I'll be going back to Izune. I just can't bear to leave while we're losing though!
To add insult to injury, those damn Blues recently went on a rampage and killed all of our lions! They didn't even spare the lionesses or the cubs.
Fortunately the work those bastards do is pretty shoddy. Go and take a look inside the damaged dens - I'm sure there will still be some cubs inside. Gather as many as you can and bring them to me. I've always had a way with animals and I'll make sure they survive.

Come here little guys! I'll be like a second mother to them. I'll feed them, keep them warm, and make sure they grow up right. I'm an orphan too, you know. I'll make sure they don't want for anything like I did!
Retrieve 3 Soldiers' Letters from the Drunken Blue Soldiers and return them to Sordush the Nomadic.

My head is spinning! I was hit on the back of the head with a blunt object while I was delivering the mail. I fell to the ground, lost consciousness, and when I came round my bag of letters was gone!
It had to be those terrible Blues! If you can get those letters back for me I'd be eternally grateful. Now that they're celebrating their victory, I'm sure they're all incredibly drunk. It should be a pretty easy task, and if they try to resist just beat them to a pulp!
Can you believe it? Attacking a postal worker! Nothing's sacred to them - they're monsters!
Where are the letters? The soldiers are waiting on news from home, notes from their loved ones, and the daily gossip! If I don't deliver them they'll rip me to shreds!

You've got the letters! Thank you so much. I used to think that being a postal worker was easy. How wrong I was!
If you must know, I think us communication professionals should be paid extra money for the risks we take. As for your help, please accept this pair of boots. I guarantee they'll keep your feet comfortable no matter how far you have to walk!
Eliminate 4 skeletons and plant the Red Flag. Report to Sarbaz Raneb afterwards.

You came at a good time.
We were just about to start the War Games! The results determine who wins - the Reds or the Blues. I'm ashamed to admit that the Reds have lost several times in a row now. It's time to put an end to this losing streak!
Here's the first task. To the south of here there is a range where employees of the Necro-Incubator release a ton of training skeletons. Your task is to break through to the center of the range and raise the Red flag. You also have to destroy at least four skeletons along the way.
The Blues have been given the same task. You need to make sure you're faster than them or it won't be our flag flying above the range.
If you succeed, report to the neutral observer Sarbaz Raneb. He collects the results of the different trials. The winning team will be chosen based on his information.
Have the skeletons have been destroyed? And did you raise your battalion's flag?
Great job! Thanks to you the Reds are now in the lead. Keep up the good work!
Destroy 4 Stone or Wind Elementals and raise the Red Flag. Report to Sarbaz Raneb at the Dead Shore Training Grounds afterwards.

Here's your second task.
Other creatures like elementals often get in our way, but we can handle them. You will show your ability to do that!
There are two types of elementals living to the east of here, earth and air ones. You need to eliminate four elementals of any type. And plant the Red Flag, of course.
Then report to Sarbaz Raneb. Remember, we are still competing against the Blues! Their commander is clearly plotting something. Be careful!
Did you make it past the elementals?
It appears that the elementals have been well and truly conquered. I must say that you've done an excellent job.
Defeat Frunt the Roughneck and talk to him.

We planted our flag first! What's the matter? Can't take losing? Well we won, fair and square!
I'm actually a bit surprised we beat you. You know, you're a living legend among the Blues - they say that you can't be burned by fire and that you can't drown in water. Those cowards, I knew it was all just empty hype.
Tell you what, how about you challenge me? I'm gonna beat you up real bad and show the rest of my battalion that you're not so scary. If you can get the better of me, then I'll take down our flag and you can plant yours in its place. Just bear in mind, I eat heroes like you for lunch!
Okay, you can plant your flag! Major Splinter is going to have my guts for garters over this. I guess I should have listened to the other soldiers.
Eliminate 4 zombies and a Necro-Rhino, and raise the Red Flag. You have 10 minutes to complete the task. Report to Sarbaz Raneb afterwards.

The region to the north of here is an experimental test area. The employees of the Necro-Incubator have decided to outdo themselves and create some new inventions. Going after more funding, I suppose.
In any case, the area is full of battle zombies which were created to complete complex operations, ones that are usually fatal to them. In a way they are kamikaze zombies, but they are serious opponents!
But that's not all - just before the start of the War Games, the workers insisted that they also test their latest innovation. Apparently it's an animal zombie. I haven't seen it yet and frankly, I don't really want to see it. It sounds pretty creepy.
As you might have guessed you, however, will be heading out there. Your third task is to fight your way through the zombies, defeat this animal zombie, and plant the Red Flag once again. I'm sure you won't let your battalion down!
That necro-rhino looked pretty menacing. Did you manage to kill it?
A worthy victory. The necro-rhino has been defeated, the zombies are dead, and another Red Flag flies proudly over the training grounds.
Report your successes to Shrinka the Nimble at the Old Barracks.

Well, now I can draw up some preliminary totals. Let's see... the Reds are winning by a landslide! It's been a while since I said that. I'm certain that all the Reds - from Colonel Shpagin to the lowliest Private - will be pleasantly surprised.
What is the next step, you ask? It's time for you to report for your next stage of training. It's going to take place at the steppes to the north. You should head on over to the Old Barracks to get your new orders.
Report to General Shrinka first. But be careful with him, he doesn't care about the war between the Reds and the Blues. The most important thing to him is training real soldiers for the Imperial Army and making sure we win the war against the League.
I congratulate you for making it through the exercises at the Dead Shore Training Grounds, but it's too soon to start relaxing.
Kill Termilla and report to Shrinka the Nimble.

Well, we need to find a proper application for your talents. It's time to stop thrashing the Blues and start fighting shoulder to shoulder, just like you'll have to do in the future. In the Holy Land every Imperial soldier is your best friend!
Right now I need a recruit for an important, honorable, and potentially fatal task. I hope you'll be pleased to hear that you have been volunteered!
Migrating termites have seized part of the Old Barracks. They're located just north of here, up on that hill. Most of the termites have been ravaging the countryside, killing everything in sight so they can bring food to their queen.
My soldiers have named her Termilla, and I suspect that she's building up her strength to lay a whole bunch of eggs. It'll probably happen soon because she's gotten quite huge! That means your task is to kill her before that happens. Send this Termilla to hell!
What's the story with Termilla? Is she really as huge as they say? And did you manage to finish her off?

So, I didn't make a mistake by sending you to deal with the termite queen! I think we need to summon the guys from the propaganda unit. They should write up your story and let the entire Empire know that no beast is too great for our army to silence.
Find Shaky Bones and give him the Spare Bone.

Good day! I'm the captain of the IMD Necromancers and I'm responsible for keeping the undead specimen in line. At the moment I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
I've just been informed that one of our minions, a skeleton who goes by the name of Shaky Bones, has run away from the base again. He seems to actually have a sense of fear, something that is unheard of in the undead, and runs at the sound of a fight. While he's rather worthless for combat purposes, his emotions make him a rare specimen and it would be a shame to lose him.
Fortunately he can't have gone far - one of his bones is badly worn and needs replacing. Go find Shaky Bones and give him this spare bone. He won't be able to replace it himself, so you should be able to convince him to come back to us.

This appears to be the skeleton that Lunina mentioned.
It would be best to treat him delicately. Who knows goes on in his empty skull?
He seems to be quite pleased with the spare bone. Maybe he'll be willing to follow you now?
Escort Shaky Bones to the Old Barracks and report to Marta Lunina.

It's probably best to escort him back to the barracks to make sure he doesn't run off again. He probably needs to be protected from any termites along the way, too. He doesn't look very strong... You wonder whether he's actually of any worth to the army.
C'mon, Shaky Bones! Time to go home little friend. There are people waiting for you!
Did you find the skeleton? He needs to be returned quickly before he gets into trouble.
Excellent. I'd give him a thrashing for running off, but it would be completely pointless. If it didn't keep him from running away the last seven times, it probably won't work this time.
Kill 4 Fierce Termites or 4 Rugged Termites in the Old Barracks Report to Eagleclaw the Wily.

The division is a disgrace! I can't believe these cowards are future soldiers of the great Empire! Goodness...
Just look at them. They're terrified of going into the Old Barracks because of the bugs! I'm scared to imagine what will happen when they have to battle against the League's soldiers!
They'll need a good kick in the rear...
Can you help me? I need a hero. To set an example for these fools. Show these cowards how it's done!
Kill four termites in the Old Barracks. Prove that a few bugs are nothing to fear!
I hope you're not afraid of termites too. I struggle to believe some of the stories that I've heard about you, but I hope it turns out that they're right.
It looks like they weren't lying about you. We could do with a few more fighters of your caliber. Let these punks look and learn!
